name: scitools-hook
title_zh: AI 代理进场前，先把圈复杂度压回绿灯的 Git 钩
tagline_zh: 每次提交前自动跑 SciTools Understand，复杂度超线就拦下。专治 AI 代理越写越绕的代码。
tagline_en: Auto-run SciTools Understand at commit time; block merges when cyclomatic complexity climbs. Keeps AI-generated.
desc_en: SciTools Understand Git pre-commit hooks to keep the complexity of code projects down for AI agents
why_zh: 不是 lint，是真正读懂控制流的度量。在 pre-commit 里卡住圈复杂度。
why_en: Real control-flow metrics, not regex lint. Enforcing complexity caps in pre-commit gives AI agents a hard brake against.
limit_zh: 只认 Git 仓库且本机要装 SciTools Understand（商业软件）。只拦复杂度，不查格式、不跑测试。
limit_en: Requires Git and SciTools Understand (commercial) installed locally. Only gates complexity—no formatting, no tests. No-op outside Git repos.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Git pre-commit hooks that cap code complexity before AI.
